race.comment: FOUR LEAF WONDER (5) resumes from a five-week freshening after doing the job in style first-up at Emerald under the big weight. Tougher now but he strips fitter with weight relief and is drawn cosy. Can win again. PROVISEUR (2) also arrives in winning form, having taken a BM60 here start after breaking through in Mdn grade the run before. Satherley sticking a bonus. PURPOSELY (7) was big odds when shedding his maiden tag here last start when overcoming some obstacles. Is still relatively lightly raced and is open to further improvement, but will need a clever steer from the wide gate. ALOYSIUS (4) is harder to trust on recent efforts, though he was respected in betting at Mackay and only has to find his earlier form to be able to sneak a minor spot.
